texts.firmware.data_rsdk.about: The data file of Sonic CD's 2011 release: everything the game is (its scripts, pictures, music and sounds). The copy that was checked is the Android release's: in its APK it is assets/Data.xmf, which is this file under another name. The Steam release's Data.rsdk is the same kind of file. You have to supply it, because this package includes none of the game's files. A file of your own can be used in its place, and the project then records its hash.
texts.property.stage_time_ms: The stage timer (minutes, seconds and hundredths), in milliseconds
texts.setting.controls.about: The engine's OriginalControls setting, which the game reads as its controls option (saved game byte 35 and the variable Options.OriginalControls). "game" leaves it to the game's own Options menu, as upstream does by default; "original" sets it on and "modern" off whatever the menu says. It changes play, so a movie records it.
texts.setting.devmenu.about: Turns on the engine's developer menu (DevMenu in its settings file), as the decompilation's settings.ini does, and adds a Dev Menu control that opens it (Escape on a PC keyboard). From the menu a stage can be chosen directly. It changes what the game does, so it is part of the project.
texts.setting.hqmodes.about: Draws the special stages' floor at twice the resolution, as upstream does by default (the engine's UseHQModes setting). The picture is then twice the size on those frames. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.language.about: The language the game's texts are in (the engine's Language setting): English, French, Italian, German, Spanish or Japanese. The game's scripts read it, so a movie records it.
texts.setting.randomseed.about: The number the engine's random numbers start from. The engine takes it from the clock when it starts (time()); here it is this number, so a movie plays the same every time. A movie records it.
texts.setting.screenwidth.about: How many pixels wide the screen is (the engine's ScreenWidth setting). 424 is upstream's default, a 16:9 screen; 320 is the 4:3 screen of the original 1993 game. The width changes how far ahead the player sees and which objects are awake, so it changes the game, and a movie records it.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The game's saves as Emulator > Export Save Data wrote them: SData.bin (the save slots' progress) and SGame.bin, under those names. They are put in place before the game starts, so the game finds them as its own. A file with another name is refused.
